title: Agent Action Preflight Brief
oneLiner: Ops teams preview what a connected work agent will touch, spend, send, or schedule before the action runs.
targetUser: Small-company operators and team leads enabling app-connected AI agents across email, files, CRM, calendars, and browser tasks.
keyUX: Paste or select an agent task, expand touched apps and risky actions, assign approval gates, and export a one-page preflight brief.
sourceSignalReferences: S1: Hada: ChatGPT Work expands app/file/browser agents - https://news.hada.io/topic?id=31281
S13: Consumer asks what to do after an official AI chatbot gave a false guarantee - https://www.reddit.com/r/LegalAdviceEurope/comments/1un8nwc/company_keeping_95_of_my_payment_after_their/
twist: Focuses on the minutes before an agent acts, not after-the-fact spend dashboards or generic permission toggles.
smallGroupFit: Any team trying app-connected agents can test it with one scheduled task or browser workflow before letting it run.
spreadTrigger: The brief can be posted in Slack or sent to a manager as the approval artifact.
stitchPrompt: Create a responsive web app called "Agent Action Preflight Brief" for small-company operators enabling app-connected AI agents. Show task intent intake, connected app touch map, sensitive action checklist, spend and runtime estimate, approval gate selector, rollback notes, audit trail, and a one-page preflight brief export. Design direction: use the operator-dense profile with compact approval rows, serious risk chips, dense app-permission matrices, and a control-room feel built for fast managerial review.
